Super Connectivity.description: Metagross links up with Super Connectivity; Metagross ex and Metagross ★ punch, and Jirachi wishes.

Losing Control.description: Tyranitar ex's Losing Control and Dark Tyranitar crush through; Larvitar evolves into whichever fits.

Driving Howl.description: Mightyena ex's Driving Howl and Absol's Shining Horn; Sableye, Murkrow and Dark Celebi lurk.

Rocket's Smog.description: Dark Crobat's Black Beam and Dark Weezing's Methane Leak poison everything; Dark Muk, Arbok and Ariados keep it sticky.

Rocket's Generator.description: Dark Ampharos and Dark Electrode charge up, Dark Magneton binds, and Rocket's Zapdos ex and Raikou ex strike.

Rocket's Undertow.description: Dark Gyarados's Dark Scale and Dark Octillery's ink; Dark Slowking schemes and Rocket's Suicune ex and Articuno ex freeze the field.

Rocket's Inferno.description: Dark Houndoom breathes fire, Dark Magcargo presses Energy and Rocket's Moltres ex and Entei ex rain ash.

Rocket's Bunker.description: Dark Marowak and Dark Steelix dig in; Rocket's Hitmonchan ex strikes back.

Rocket's Dark Trance.description: Dark Dragonite rises on Evolutionary Light; Dark Hypno and Dark Raticate keep the opponent drowsy.

Rocket's Night Cry.description: Rocket's Persian ex cries in the night; Rocket's Mewtwo ex, Snorlax ex and Scizor ex lead the grunts.

Delta Dragons.description: Dragonite δ charges the bench with Delta Charge; Salamence δ blasts and Rayquaza δ guards with Delta Guard.

Holon Flame.description: Tyranitar δ crushes and draws, Kingdra δ curses with Dragon Curse; Mewtwo δ and Gyarados ★ blow up the field.

Delta Storm.description: Metagross δ controls the field, Pidgeot δ holds energy in reserve and Gyarados δ's Delta Reactor powers the team.

Delta Prism.description: Eevee δ evolves into the Holon Eeveelutions: Espeon δ heals, Umbreon δ moons and Vaporeon δ, Flareon δ and Jolteon δ search.

Holon Bloom.description: Bellossom δ's Fellowship and Vileplume δ's Poison Pollen; Starmie δ navigates, Azumarill δ rolls and Latios δ dives.

Holon Circuit.description: The Holon's Magneton, Electrode and Castform double as Energy; Raichu δ and Persian δ cash in.

Delta Swarm.description: Flygon δ supplies Energy with Delta Supply; Beedrill δ stings and Crobat δ jams radar.

Delta Pack.description: Mightyena δ, Sandslash δ and Marowak δ hunt together; Sharpedo δ and Exeggutor δ split the damage.

Dark Palm.description: Dusknoir sends the opponent's Pokémon back with Dark Palm; Gengar, Banette ex and Mismagius haunt the bench.

Imprison.description: Gardevoir heals with Heal Dance and Gardevoir ex locks Poké-Powers with Imprison; Xatu and Wynaut back them up.

Type Shift.description: Claydol ex shifts types at will; Lunatone, Solrock and Grumpig keep the cosmic cycle turning.

Unown Puzzle.description: Unown A, B, C and D spell out their powers while Jirachi ex shines and Alakazam ★ copies attacks.

Forme Shift.description: Deoxys and Deoxys ex change Forme under Space Center; Starmie navigates and Deoxys δ joins the shift.

Ominous Wind.description: Drifblim drifts in with Explosive Smoke, Drapion poisons and Slowking shifts prizes.

Mythical Mew.description: Mew ex sees everything with Psychic Vision; Mewtwo ★, Celebi ex and Lugia keep the bench mysterious.

Evolution Rays.description: Eevee evolves into the ex Eeveelutions; Espeon ★ shines a Purple Ray, and Ho-Oh ex and Lugia ex feed on the same rainbow of Energy.

Volt Tackle.description: Raichu ex fires Pika Bolt and Electivire unleashes Intense Voltage; Pikachu ★ springs back.

Gleam Eyes.description: Luxray's Gleam Eyes drags out the target; Pachirisu runs errands while Plusle, Minun and Raikou ★ cheer.

Static Flock.description: Ampharos connects Energy across the bench while Manectric ex disconnects; Rocket's Raikou ex bursts and Jolteon ★'s Yellow Ray finishes.

Magnetize.description: Magnezone pulls Energy with Magnetize; Magneton recharges and Electrode blows up for a big swing.

Fire Fang.description: Charizard roars back from Charmeleon while Charizard ★ swirls the dark; Moltres ex and Magmar hold the front.

Burn Away.description: Blaziken ex burns everything away; Camerupt ex erupts and Arbok's burning venom smolders.

Flame Swirl.description: Typhlosion's Burning Aura and Arcanine ex's Flame Swirl; Entei ★ detonates and Rapidash stomps.

Flare Up.description: Infernape and Infernape LV.X flare up with Burning Head; Ninetales, Houndoom and Flareon ★ keep the heat on.

Forest Murmurs.description: Torterra and Torterra LV.X dash through with Forest Murmurs; Carnivine swallows, Cherrim worries and Celebi ★ travels in time.

Solar Garden.description: Venusaur and Meganium ex nurture the field; Sunflora dances and Shuckle holds tight.

Attack Order.description: Vespiquen calls the swarm with Attack Order; Roserade whips, Ledian punches and Yanma zips in.

Dark Eyes.description: Shiftry ex's Dark Eyes punish every Poké-Power; Shiftry fans away and Cacturne's Spike Storm finishes.

Silk Road.description: Dustox ex blows Silver Wind and Dustox spreads toxic dust; Beautifly lures and Masquerain intimidates.

Poison Ring.description: Crobat ex stacks poison; Weezing, Muk and Ariados make sure it never wears off. Seviper waits on the bench.

Leaf Blade.description: Sceptile's Green Essence and Sceptile ex's Extra Liquid; Breloom poisons and Scyther slashes.

Stun Spore Garden.description: Bellossom dances and Vileplume spreads Poison Pollen; Victreebel and Swalot trap.

Loose Shell.description: Ninjask and Shedinja split from Nincada; Beedrill stings and Forretress pops.

Dark Horn.description: Nidoking δ gores with Dark Horn while Nidoqueen δ sends Invitations; the Nidoran pair grows up together.

Fossil Charge.description: Lileep and Anorith revive into Cradily, Armaldo and Armaldo ex; Relicanth lifts them from the depths.

Ancient Shell.description: Mysterious Fossil, Holon Fossil and Old Rod bring back Kabutops, Omastar and Aerodactyl; Lapras navigates.

Brine.description: Empoleon and Empoleon LV.X slice with Ice Blade; Floatzel screws in and Manaphy calls the family.

Pincer Pond.description: Kingler, Crawdaunt ex and Seaking pinch and splash from the water; Latios ex and Palkia keep watch over the pond.

Whale Watch.description: Wailord lifts the team with Reactive Lift; Pelipper and Luvdisc pull cards and Energy along, and Mew ★ mimics the rest.

Protective Swirl.description: Kingdra ex's Extra Smoke protects it while Protective Swirl hits hard; Octillery holds on with Suction Cups.

Rain Splash.description: Milotic ex reflects Energy; Ludicolo's Swing Dance and Azumarill's Froth keep it going under Rain Castform.

Glacia's Blizzard.description: Walrein ex's Icy Aura and Glalie's Ice Wall under Glacia's Stadium; the Regice trio and Articuno ex freeze the field.

Frozen Kiss.description: Dewgong, Cloyster and Starmie from Kanto's seas; Jynx and Smoochum blow kisses and Suicune ★ blows a Cross Wind.

Ultra Pump.description: Swampert ex recycles Energy and Swampert echoes draws; Quagsire and Whiscash dig in.

Smash Turn.description: Blastoise smash-turns in and out; Poliwrath and Politoed ex bounce in and Tentacruel stings.

Hydro Fangs.description: Gyarados rises from Magikarp; Sharpedo ex and Huntail cut through and Vaporeon ★ whirls the water.

Primal Tide.description: Kyogre ex and Kyogre ★ crash the waves; Palkia rends space and Latios ex links wings.

Tsunami Fang.description: Feraligatr's Intimidating Fang and Feraligatr ex's Tsunami; Sudowoodo and Bonsly copy the tears.

Salamence Sky.description: Salamence ex shoots Bright Flame with Dragon Lift; Altaria ex spreads mist, Rayquaza ★ shines and Blissey ex supports from the bench.

Eon Duet.description: Latias ex boosts her fellows and Latios ex links wings; the shining Latios ★ strikes with any Energy.

Slack Attack.description: Slaking's Critical Move hits for 100; Zangoose, Snorlax, Munchlax and Lopunny's Healing Wish round out the normal team.

Sand Pit.description: Flygon ex's Emerge Charge powers up; Marowak, Gligar and Sandslash δ make a ground squad, and Latias ★ shines a Healing Light.

Brave Bird.description: Staraptor's Brave Heart and Dodrio's Fast Feet; Pidgeot searches and Chatot copies the first move.

Moon Kick.description: Clefable's Extra Comet Punch and Wigglytuff's Expand; Delcatty ex constrains the opponent's hand and Granbull bares its fangs.

High Hat.description: Purugly's High Hat and Persian's claws; Linoone, Furret, Ursaring, Aipom and Dunsparce swarm the bench.

Scavenge.description: Bibarel scavenges the discard pile while Exploud ex makes Extra Noise; Porygon2, Ditto, Fearow, Swellow and Noctowl keep the team flexible.

Aura Sphere.description: Lucario fires Aura Sphere while Medicham ex meditates; the Hitmon trio take turns in the ring.

Dynamic Punch.description: Machamp hits harder the more damaged it is; Hariyama ex and Primeape fight alongside.

Earth Fissure.description: Rhyperior wrecks rocks with Earth Fissure; Golem rolls, Hippowdon ejects sand and Groudon ★ slashes the ground.

Ground Slash.description: Donphan and Dugtrio shake the ground; Regirock ex heals with Healing Stone and Groudon ex crushes.

Metal Gravity.description: Aggron ex's Intimidating Armor and Skarmory ex's Metal Gravity; the Registeel trio and Dialga hold the line.

Steel Slash.description: Steelix's Metal Slash and Scizor ex's Steel Wing; Dialga bellows through time.

Meteor Fist.description: Metagross links up with Super Connectivity; Metagross ★ punches and Jirachi ex shines its Star Light.

Shatter.description: Tyranitar ex shatters the field with Losing Control; Pupitar rolls in from Larvitar.

Cursed Eyes.description: Absol ex curses the opponent's Pokémon with Cursed Eyes; Mightyena ex howls, Weavile plots, Skuntank gasses and Umbreon ★ casts a Dark Ray.

Holon Inferno.description: Tyranitar δ crushes and draws, Kingdra δ curses with Dragon Curse; Mewtwo δ and Gyarados ★ blow up the field.

Holon Eevees.description: Eevee δ evolves into the Holon Eeveelutions: Espeon δ heals, Umbreon δ moons and Vaporeon δ, Flareon δ and Jolteon δ search.

Delta Bouquet.description: Bellossom δ's Fellowship and Vileplume δ's Poison Pollen; Starmie δ navigates, Azumarill δ rolls and Latios δ dives.

Psychic Mirage.description: Flygon ex δ, Ninetales δ and Typhlosion δ burn with psychic flames from Holon's frontier.

Delta Hunters.description: Mightyena δ, Sandslash δ and Marowak δ hunt together; Sharpedo δ and Exeggutor δ split the damage.

Dragon Frontiers.description: Gardevoir ex δ and Meganium δ burn bright from Holon's frontier; Heracross δ and Pinsir δ join the fight.
